# Akshara project instructions

- This is a dependency-free browser app. Keep the app runnable by opening `index.html` directly.
- Keep the lesson experience responsive, keyboard accessible, and usable with mouse or touch.
- Keep language content grouped by language in `app.js`; check native-script spelling, transliteration, and English meanings carefully.
- Persist only learner settings and progress in local storage. Do not add analytics or send learner data over the network.
- Follow the existing visual system in `styles.css` and preserve support for all five scripts.
